intuition: A sorted value can appear twice in the result; any third copy is adjacent to two already kept copies.

brute_force.approach: Count each run and append at most two copies to a new list.

optimal.approach: Write a value only if fewer than two values are kept or it differs from the value two positions behind the write pointer.

edge_cases: Empty and short arrays are already valid.
A run of any length contributes at most two values.
Only the returned prefix is part of the answer.
